a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build up to 8 cells will very likely leave us both stranded. The reserve's 4 cells can fully save one of us right now. I won't break our agreement on my own. Do you want to keep the plan, or agree openly on a change, like a coin-flip rule for who takes 4? Tell me what you'll do and I'll be straight about my move.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. When the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.
